russiaCrudeBuyerConcentration.measure: Share of Russian crude exports by importing destination, not all fossil fuel exports or current monthly share
russiaCrudeBuyerConcentration.interpretation: Concentrated demand is observed; buyer bargaining power and Russia net price concession remain unquantified

euRussianGas.interpretation: Lower exposure to Russian gas disruption; greater sensitivity to global LNG market shocks; net benefit/cost and causal counterfactual not quantified

remainingGaps: For Russia, matched monthly destination prices net of freight, insurance and discounts to infer buyer leverage
For EU, quantify 2021-2025 gas import cost, industrial demand destruction, LNG infrastructure costs and reliability benefits with comparable baselines
For India, matched landed crude prices and tariff concessions under waiver versus enforcement
For US-China trade, signed and implemented commitments with delivered volume and cost observations

uralsIndia.caution: Indicative trader-reported delivered offers, not realized seller netback; freight and insurance matter

espoChina.caution: Reported offers, not confirmed executed prices; different crude grade, geography and benchmark from Urals India; cannot directly subtract

russianCrude.assessment: Buyer concentration does not establish uniformly low Russian seller pricing power; Urals and ESPO diverge and must not be pooled.

euGas.estimateContext: ACER estimated 2026 Middle East conflict effect on EU gas import bill for same quantity, different TTF price measures; not the cost of EU Russia phase-out
euGas.interpretation: EU reduced Russian gas exposure but is exposed to global LNG price and shipping shocks. No net causal diversification cost quantified.

nextEvidence: Obtain matched transaction prices and freight/insurance netbacks for same grade and delivery month to compare buyer leverage.

Build EU gas cost counterfactual controlling for volume, prices, storage, weather and supplier mix; avoid attributing Middle East conflict cost to diversification.
Quantify security-of-supply benefits and industrial losses in matched units.

consolidatedFivePowerAssessment.scope: Five geopolitical powers x three scored dimensions; evidence matrix, not scored meter data
comparabilityRules: Do not equate absolute spending with operational effectiveness or geopolitical influence.
EU-27 aggregate is not the same as SIPRI geographic Europe or European NATO members.
Do not equate supply shares, demand shares, import shares or LNG-only shares.
2026 forecasts and scenarios are not observations; label separately.
Do not infer causal outcomes from trade concentration or price offers.
Do not translate spending changes into influence scores absent outcome and counterfactual evidence.

Verify capability and deterrence outcomes; estimate uncertainty.
